settings.heading: Contact us
settings.text: Call, WhatsApp or drop in to our workshop in Ballymount, Dublin 12.
settings.big_phone_note: Quickest for a quote: send your reg and a photo of your dash.

settings.heading: Send us a message
settings.intro: Tell us about your car and what you'd like done. We'll come back to you with a price.
settings.step_1_text: We look up your reg and factory screen to confirm which CarPlay, screen or audio kit suits your car.
settings.step_2_text: One clear price for parts and fitting, sent by phone, WhatsApp or email before any work starts.
settings.step_3_text: Pick a time that suits you. A €50 deposit holds your slot, and most installs are done in one to two hours.
settings.form_text: Name, mobile and email are all we need. The car details help us answer faster.
